meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. This is a count of public CMS inspection and penalty records, kept for marketing planning. A citation is an inspector's finding, not a court's; a fine can be reduced or withdrawn on appeal; and nothing here says any home or person did anything unlawful.

records.text: Alaska: 20 Medicare- or Medicaid-certified nursing homes (815 certified beds). CMS fined 5 of them 11 times for $531,436 between October 2023 and September 2026, and denied payment 3 times (37 days). Inspectors cited 22 deficiencies at the actual-harm level or worse (4 immediate jeopardy) and 35 abuse or neglect deficiencies in the inspections CMS publishes. 5.0% of rated homes have one star overall.
records.unit: dollars of CMS fines in the last three years
